experiment_template.research_question: Does deterministic source retrieval preserve full-S long-history answers at8K with at least15% fewer complete model tokens than sequential compact-note ingestion?
stop_conditions: Fixed eight answer slots and failed-call costs
Same pinned S evaluator identity, references isolated until global seal
Unknown usage, provider capacity, shared health or persistence stops dispatch

records.falsifier: Incomplete treatment answers, native quality failure, less than15% savings or unresolved accounting.
records.mechanism: Complete query-free compact-note ingestion versus source-only user-priority lexical retrieval; same final scope policy and exact8K.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exact8K four fixed full-S long-history pairs; bounded confirmation, not full-benchmark perfection.
records.statement: Deterministic retrieval preserves required long-history answers while reducing complete model tokens by at least15%.
